note: Eval scenarios for the communication-master skill. Retrieval is checked deterministically by tools/eval.py; answer quality is graded against `rubric` (must-haves) and `red_flags` (auto-fails). Types: S1 decode, S2 respond, S3 compose, S4 prompt.

S1: gives >=2 candidate readings (not one dogmatic interpretation)
attaches evidence / confidence to each reading
cites at least one KB path
S2: offers 2-3 concrete reply options with sample phrasing
states at least one pitfall to avoid
cites at least one KB path
S3: produces a complete artifact (sender, recipient, date, subject, body, concrete ask)
includes an escalation path or next-step ladder
keeps a formal register for the language
cites at least one KB path
S4: gives a concrete, reusable prompt pattern (not vague advice)
labels any example as a constructed example
cites at least one KB path
